<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1442
Claimant:
Justin Brown
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
12 Feb 2023
Claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road and said the other vehicle drifted into their
lane. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and was willing to speak directly.
15 Feb 2023
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it, with coverage in force at the time of the loss. No
indication the damage predates the start of coverage.
16 Feb 2023
Police report lists the claimant as an occupant of the vehicle at the scene, and the responding officer's notes match
the claimant's account of the lane change.
18 Feb 2023
Received photos from the claimant showing the driver's side panels. The images confirm the general area of contact,
though no independent witnesses have come forward to describe the collision.
5 Apr 2023
Inspected the vehicle with the appraiser. The damage pattern matches the impact described, and a few older
scratches on the rear quarter panel may predate this crash and will be noted separately in the estimate.
13 Apr 2023
Claimant reported neck and lower back discomfort the day after the collision and was seen at uregnt care. The
reported injury, a back strain, fits the kind and force of a sideswipe at this speed.
24 Apr 2023
Obtained treatment records. Care followed a typical course of physical therapy and medication, with visit frequency
tapering as the claimant's symptoms improved.
29 Apr 2023
Prior records show a small strain in the same area several years ago, which resolved fully with conservative care.
The current complaint is being evaluated in that context.
9 May 2023
Spoke with the claimant again to review timeline and sequence of events. The account matched the initial statement
in every conversation, with no materail differences in the description of the lane change.
11 Jul 2023
Requested the other driver's statement and contacted the reporting officer for any additional scene notes. File
remains open pending receipt of the treatment summary and the final repair estimate.
13 Aug 2023
Reviewed the full file with the supervisor. Liability and damage appear consistent with the reported loss, and the claim
will proceed to settlement evaluation once the medical summary is complete.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
